zh_CN.description: 投射物与命中套件 的静态视觉资产。

en.name: Projectile and Hit Kit
en.description: Static visual asset for Projectile and Hit Kit.

zh_CN.name: 防弹内衬
zh_CN.description: 一块可塞进战术背心的硬质防弹插板。
zh_CN.flavor: 边角满是跳弹擦痕，中心仍牢牢护住胸口。

en.name: Ballistic Liner
en.description: A rigid ballistic plate sized for a tactical vest.
en.flavor: Ricochet scars crowd the edges; the center still holds.

zh_CN.name: 静步鞋垫
zh_CN.description: 一双吸震凝胶战术鞋垫，能压低落脚声。
zh_CN.flavor: 塞进跑鞋后，B点木门也听不见脚步。

en.name: Silent-Step Insoles
en.description: A pair of shock-absorbing gel insoles for tactical shoes.
en.flavor: Slip them into your runners and even the B-site floor stays quiet.

zh_CN.name: 准星校片
zh_CN.description: 用于微调瞄具高度的金属校准垫片。
zh_CN.flavor: 薄得像贴纸，却能把偏掉的瞄线扶正。

en.name: Crosshair Shim
en.description: A metal shim plate for fine sight-height calibration.
en.flavor: Sticker-thin, yet sturdy enough to straighten a wandering sight.

zh_CN.name: 补给雷达
zh_CN.description: 带折叠天线和绿屏的手持补给雷达。
zh_CN.flavor: 亮点出现时，总有人先喊“我的箱子”。

en.name: Supply Radar
en.description: A handheld supply radar with a folding antenna and green screen.
en.flavor: When a blip appears, somebody always calls dibs on the crate.

zh_CN.name: 补枪护腕
zh_CN.description: 带厚衬垫的战术前臂护具。
zh_CN.flavor: 它替补枪手挡住门框，也挡住第一颗流弹。

en.name: Trade Guard
en.description: A thickly padded tactical forearm guard.
en.flavor: It catches the doorframe—and sometimes the first stray round.

zh_CN.name: 战术急救贴
zh_CN.description: 装在密封小袋里的止血急救贴。
zh_CN.flavor: 撕开、按住，再回去补那一枪。

en.name: Tactical Med Patch
en.description: A sealed pouch containing a pressure-seal trauma patch.
en.flavor: Tear, press, then get back in time for the trade.

zh_CN.name: 封烟头盔
zh_CN.description: 装有滤烟壳体的战术头盔。
zh_CN.flavor: 烟里看不清人，但这顶橙壳很好认。

en.name: Smoke-Shell Helmet
en.description: A tactical helmet fitted with a smoke-filter shell.
en.flavor: Nobody sees through the smoke, but everyone spots the orange shell.

zh_CN.name: 强起跑鞋
zh_CN.description: 一双轻量战术跑鞋，鞋底抓地很硬。
zh_CN.flavor: 钱不够买甲，至少还能先跑到点。

en.name: Force-Buy Runners
en.description: Lightweight tactical runners with hard-gripping soles.
en.flavor: No money for armor; at least you can reach the site first.

zh_CN.name: 经济局零钱袋
zh_CN.description: 装着零散经济局硬币的小腰包。
zh_CN.flavor: 每一枚都在劝你别再强起。

en.name: Eco-Round Coin Pouch
en.description: A small belt pouch filled with loose eco-round coins.
en.flavor: Every coin inside is begging you not to force-buy again.

zh_CN.name: 反弹火线瓶
zh_CN.description: 绑着耐热布条的厚玻璃燃烧瓶。
zh_CN.flavor: 瓶身磕过墙角，火还没有灭。

en.name: Rebound Fire Bottle
en.description: A thick glass fire bottle wrapped with a heatproof cloth strip.
en.flavor: The bottle clipped a corner; the flame did not.

zh_CN.name: 突破手哑铃
zh_CN.description: 给突破手热身用的短柄哑铃。
zh_CN.flavor: 举两下，然后第一个冲过烟。

en.name: Entry-Fragger Dumbbell
en.description: A short-handled dumbbell for an entry fragger's warm-up.
en.flavor: Two quick reps, then straight through the smoke.

zh_CN.name: 夹点幸运爪
zh_CN.description: 带金属爪饰的幸运钥匙扣。
zh_CN.flavor: 挂在枪袋上，转角时总朝幸运那边晃。

en.name: Corner Lucky Claw
en.description: A lucky keychain finished with a small metal claw.
en.flavor: It swings toward the lucky side whenever you clear a corner.

zh_CN.name: 灼热拆包钳
zh_CN.description: 被火熏黑的绝缘拆弹钳。
zh_CN.flavor: 胶皮焦了，钳口依旧能剪线。

en.name: Scorched Defuse Pliers
en.description: Insulated defuse pliers blackened by heat.
en.flavor: The grips are scorched; the jaws can still cut the wire.

zh_CN.name: 保枪倒计表
zh_CN.description: 显示回合倒计时的耐冲击电子表。
zh_CN.flavor: 滴答声提醒你：这把枪值得活着带走。

en.name: Save-Time Watch
en.description: A shock-resistant digital watch showing the round countdown.
en.flavor: Its ticking asks whether that rifle is worth saving.

zh_CN.name: 天外高抛雷
zh_CN.description: 缠着定位胶带的分片高爆手雷。
zh_CN.flavor: 胶带标着天空线，拉环只等那声口令。

en.name: Skyline Grenade
en.description: A fragmentation grenade wrapped with lineup tape.
en.flavor: The tape marks the skyline; the pin waits for the call.

zh_CN.name: 赛后复盘台
zh_CN.description: 带折叠支架和笔记本电脑的复盘台。
zh_CN.flavor: 录像暂停在那次没人愿意承认的空枪。

en.name: Post-Match Analysis Desk
en.description: A folding analysis desk carrying an open laptop.
en.flavor: The replay is paused on the whiff nobody wants to claim.

zh_CN.name: 裂镜纪念盒
zh_CN.description: 装着裂纹瞄准镜片的硬质纪念盒。
zh_CN.flavor: 盒里保留着那一发，也保留着所有借口。

en.name: Cracked-Scope Keepsake
en.description: A hard keepsake case holding a cracked scope lens.
en.flavor: It preserves the missed shot—and every excuse that followed.

zh_CN.name: 坠线狙击挂件
zh_CN.description: 由链环悬挂的迷你狙击枪挂件。
zh_CN.flavor: 枪口朝下晃，提醒你落地前先稳住。

en.name: Falling Sniper Charm
en.description: A miniature sniper-rifle charm hanging from a chain ring.
en.flavor: It swings muzzle-down as a reminder to steady before landing.

zh_CN.name: 垫点折凳
zh_CN.description: 可折叠的防滑垫点小凳。
zh_CN.flavor: 站上去以后，窗口突然就不高了。

en.name: Boost Step Stool
en.description: A folding step stool with a non-slip top.
en.flavor: Stand on it and the window suddenly stops looking tall.

zh_CN.name: 赛后嘴硬麦
zh_CN.description: 带防震架的桌面广播麦克风。
zh_CN.flavor: 赛后先别关麦，借口还没说完。

en.name: Post-Match Mic
en.description: A desktop broadcast microphone in a shock mount.
en.flavor: Keep the mic live; the post-match excuses are not finished.

zh_CN.name: 半场战术板
zh_CN.description: 夹着回合草图的硬质战术夹板。
zh_CN.flavor: 旧路线全擦掉了，只剩“别单摸”。

en.name: Halftime Tactics Board
en.description: A rigid tactics clipboard holding a round sketch.
en.flavor: The old routes are erased; only “do not solo peek” remains.

zh_CN.name: 手炮五杀币
zh_CN.description: 刻着五杀记号的厚重纪念币。
zh_CN.flavor: 边缘已经被紧张的拇指磨亮。

en.name: Hand-Cannon Ace Coin
en.description: A heavy commemorative coin engraved for an ace.
en.flavor: A nervous thumb has polished its rim bright.

zh_CN.name: 静步面罩
zh_CN.description: 露出眼口的黑色针织巴拉克拉法帽。
zh_CN.flavor: 戴上它，连队友都要多看一眼雷达。

en.name: Sneaky-Site Mask
en.description: A black knitted balaclava with eye and mouth openings.
en.flavor: Put it on and even teammates double-check the radar.

zh_CN.name: 主场合唱磁带
zh_CN.description: 录着主场助威声的便携磁带。
zh_CN.flavor: 按下播放，观众席立刻多了八百人。

en.name: Arena Chant Cassette
en.description: A portable cassette loaded with home-arena chants.
en.flavor: Press play and the stands gain eight hundred voices.

zh_CN.name: 抬鼠垫
zh_CN.description: 带抬腕斜坡的加厚鼠标垫。
zh_CN.flavor: 垫高几毫米，甩枪就有了新理由。

en.name: Mouse-Lift Pad
en.description: A thick mouse pad built with a raised wrist ramp.
en.flavor: A few extra millimeters give every flick a new excuse.

zh_CN.name: 道具点位粉笔
zh_CN.description: 带护套和夹扣的战术粉笔座。
zh_CN.flavor: 粉笔只画一次投掷点，雨来了也不心疼。

en.name: Lineup Chalk
en.description: A tactical chalk holder with a sleeve and belt clip.
en.flavor: It marks one grenade spot, then shrugs off the rain.

zh_CN.name: 守点头巾
zh_CN.description: 印有守点纹样的折叠头巾。
zh_CN.flavor: 系紧以后，退点听起来更像战术转移。

en.name: Site-Hold Bandana
en.description: A folded bandana printed with a site-hold pattern.
en.flavor: Tie it tight and a retreat starts sounding like a rotation.

zh_CN.name: 腾空狙击翼章
zh_CN.description: 带环扣的金属翼形狙击挂件。
zh_CN.flavor: 它不会让子弹飞，但会让空枪更显眼。

en.name: Airshot Wing Charm
en.description: A metal wing-shaped sniper charm with a clasp ring.
en.flavor: It cannot make bullets fly, but it makes a whiff more visible.

zh_CN.name: 残局秒表
zh_CN.description: 带护壳的残局计时秒表。
zh_CN.flavor: 每一秒都比脚步声响。

en.name: Clutch Stopwatch
en.description: A clutch stopwatch protected by a hard shell.
en.flavor: Every second sounds louder than a footstep.

zh_CN.name: 三发节奏弹匣
zh_CN.description: 刻有三道节奏纹的弧形步枪弹匣。
zh_CN.flavor: 第三发总想穿过第二个人。

en.name: Three-Beat Magazine
en.description: A curved rifle magazine etched with three rhythm stripes.
en.flavor: The third round is always looking for a second target.

zh_CN.name: 重甲头盔
zh_CN.description: 带加厚面罩和后颈护片的重型战术头盔。
zh_CN.flavor: 头铁可以，这次真有头甲。

en.name: Heavy Assault Helmet
en.description: A heavy tactical helmet with a reinforced visor and rear neck guard.
en.flavor: Hard-headed is fine when you finally bought head armor.

zh_CN.name: 轻量战术靴
zh_CN.description: 一双削薄鞋底、加硬脚跟的轻量战术靴。
zh_CN.flavor: Rush B 不等人，鞋带也不等。

en.name: Lightweight Tactical Boots
en.description: Lightweight tactical boots with thin soles and reinforced heels.
en.flavor: Rush B waits for nobody—not even untied laces.

zh_CN.name: 爆头靶纸
zh_CN.description: 一张夹在硬背板上的纸靶，头部留着密集弹孔。
zh_CN.flavor: Aim Botz 打了半小时，实战先空一发。

en.name: Headshot Target Sheet
en.description: A paper target clipped to a hard backing, with a tight group of holes around the head.
en.flavor: Half an hour in Aim Botz, then the first live shot still misses.

zh_CN.name: 经济局硬币弹匣
zh_CN.description: 把硬币塞进空弹匣做成的随身零钱盒。
zh_CN.flavor: 这回真别强起。

en.name: Eco-Round Coin Magazine
en.description: An empty magazine repurposed as a pocket coin holder.
en.flavor: Seriously, no force buy this round.

zh_CN.name: 凯夫拉插板组
zh_CN.description: 四块用粗绑带扎紧的凯夫拉防弹插板。
zh_CN.flavor: 没头甲，至少这次真的有甲。

en.name: Kevlar Plate Stack
en.description: Four Kevlar ballistic plates cinched together with heavy straps.
en.flavor: No helmet, but at least this time there is actual armor.

zh_CN.name: 医疗针
zh_CN.description: 一支带宽药筒和护帽的战地医疗针。
zh_CN.flavor: 打一针，再 peek 同一个角。

en.name: Medi-Shot
en.description: A battlefield injector with a wide medicine barrel and protected nozzle.
en.flavor: Take the shot, then peek the same angle again.

zh_CN.name: 训练场整幅背景
zh_CN.description: 单张完整训练场背景，保留清晰场界与开阔战斗中心。

en.name: Training-Ground Arena Base
en.description: One complete arena background with a visible perimeter and clear combat center.

zh_CN.name: 场界边框
zh_CN.description: 场界边框 的静态视觉资产。

en.description: Static visual asset for Arena Boundary Border.
